name: exp_x2ma_jjrsx
summary: This EA generates trading signals based on the crossover of two moving averages (x2MA) combined with the Jurik RSX (JJRSX) momentum indicator as a filter. It enters long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and JJRSX confirms bullish momentum, and enters short on the reverse conditions. The strategy is a systematic trend-following system with momentum confirmation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于两条移动平均线的交叉信号（x2MA）结合Jurik RSX（JJRSX）动量指标作为过滤条件来生成交易信号。当快线上穿慢线且JJRSX确认看涨动量时做多，反之为做空。这是一个带有动量确认的系统性趋势跟踪策略。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是双移动平均线交叉系统配合Jurik RSX动量指标过滤。入场条件为：做多时快线MA上穿慢线MA，同时JJRSX指标处于上升状态或高于某个阈值；做空则反之。双MA交叉是经典的趋势跟踪方法，而JJRSX作为平滑的动量指标，相比普通RSI减少了噪音信号，能有效过滤假突破和震荡行情中的虚假交叉。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或JJRSX动量反转。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但具体的风控机制取决于参数配置。整体而言，该策略在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a dual moving average crossover system filtered by the Jurik RSX momentum indicator. Entry conditions are: go long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA while JJRSX confirms bullish momentum (rising or above a threshold), and go short on the reverse. The dual MA crossover is a classic trend-following approach, while JJRSX serves as a smoothed momentum indicator that reduces signal noise compared to standard RSI, effectively filtering out false breakouts and whipsaws in ranging markets. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or JJRSX momentum reversal. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, and some versions may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters, though the specific risk controls depend on parameter configuration. Overall, this strategy performs well in clearly trending markets but may generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses in choppy, range-bound conditions.
pros: 双指标过滤减少了单一MA交叉系统的假信号，Jurik RSX的平滑特性显著降低信号噪音
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性强，适合不同市场环境下的优化
趋势跟踪策略在明确趋势行情中表现稳健，盈亏比潜力较大
pros_en: Dual indicator filtering reduces false signals compared to a single MA crossover system; JJRSX's smoothing characteristic significantly reduces signal noise
Clear and understandable strategy logic with highly adjustable parameters, suitable for optimization across different market conditions
Trend-following strategy performs robustly in clear trending markets with good risk-reward ratio potential
cons: 双MA交叉系统天然存在滞后性，入场时趋势可能已经走了一段，导致利润缩水
震荡行情中MA交叉频繁发生，即使有JJRSX过滤仍可能产生连续亏损
默认止损和止盈为0，若用户不手动设置则缺乏基本风险保护，存在较大资金风险
cons_en: The dual MA crossover system inherently suffers from lag; by the time entry signals fire, the trend may already be well underway, reducing potential profit
In ranging markets, MA crossovers occur frequently, and even with JJRSX filtering, consecutive losses are still possible
Default stop loss and take profit are set to 0, meaning without manual configuration the EA lacks basic risk protection, posing significant capital risk
improvements: 增加新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓；添加点差过滤，防止高滑点环境下入场
引入移动止损或追踪止损机制，在趋势行情中锁定利润；增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，自适应市场波动性
添加交易时段过滤，避免在低流动性时段交易；增加最大持仓数量和最大回撤限制的资金管理模块
improvements_en: Add new bar checking to prevent repeated entries within the same candle; add spread filtering to avoid entries in high-spread environments
Introduce trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits during trending moves; add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for adaptive volatility management
Add trading session filtering to avoid trading during low-liquidity periods; implement maximum position count and maximum drawdown limits as money management modules

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，未设置时仓位完全裸露于市场风险中，可能导致单笔巨额亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线内多次开仓导致过度交易
MA交叉策略在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续小亏累积
risk_points_en: Default SL/TP of 0 leaves positions fully exposed to market risk without configuration, potentially leading to massive single-trade losses
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple entries within the same candle, leading to overtrading
MA crossover strategy may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, causing accumulated losses from consecutive small losses
